tei:div.tei:p: ye shes rab 'bar las: rdo rje brtsegs pa srung ba'i rim pa ni: 'gro 'dul he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: ྈྈྈྈ ye shes rab 'bar rtsa rgyud las byung zhing: gang 'dul thabs mkhas 'gro 'dul cha rkyen du: lha 'dre'i 'tshe ba srung ba'i 'khor lo ni: rdo rje brtsegs pa sra ba'i go cha'o: sa ma ya: mu khyud drug ldan gsum par rtsibs brgyad bcas: lte bar sku gsung thugs snying 'dod gsol spel: mu khyud gnyis gsum zhi drag spel tshig bcas: rtsibs brgyad me dbal rtse mo sdig pas mtshon: phyi rim mu khyud drag sngags so lnga pa'i: sham dang rtsibs mchan gang srung 'dod pa spel: phyi rim rten 'brel dbyangs gsal me ris bskor: bri ba'i rdzas ni rgya snag bzang po drug: byugs pa'i rdzas ni pañtsa a mṛta: dmigs su kha bsgyur gza' la spos dkar dang: rgyal por gu gul klu la gla rtsi dang: btsan la shu dag gnyan la khyung lnga byug: rab gnas brtan bzhugs byin 'bebs gnas su bzhugs: dam tshig che yon drod sbyar dag snang bskyed: snyigs dus 'gro ba'i zug rngu sel phyir te: skal ldan rjes 'jug rnams kyis spyod par shog: sa ma ya: drag po srog bdag gis srungs shig: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: rgya rgya rgya: zhes gnam chen brag dkar nas spyan drangs pa'i shog ser las/ klong gsal snying pos khol ri sgrub khang rtser bshus pa'i yi ge'i mthun rkyen bkra shis blo gros kyis so/// /
